name: Into the Field
summary: In Tanaris, you test desert creatures with Apothecary Zinge’s field testing kit. Its power source must come from Gadgetzan’s goblins, so Zinge sends you to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.

sections.title: Tissue in the Desert
sections.body: Apothecary Zinge needs to know whether tissue from Tanaris basilisks, scorpids and hyenas is consistent. You gather samples and test them with the field testing kit. Many will fail, so Zinge needs eight acceptable samples of each kind. Return only when you have them.

sections.title: A Power Source in Gadgetzan
sections.body: The modified kit needs a power source like those held by Gadgetzan’s goblins. Zinge sends you to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan to get one.

sections.title: Nothing Is Free
sections.body: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle knows the model 4711-FTZ power sources well. They usually run the water wells, and the vile nomads have left plenty behind just now. Bilgewhizzle will arrange one for whatever experiment you are trying to hide. But not for free. In Gadgetzan, nothing is.

faq.q: Who sends you to Tanaris for this research?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge sends you into Tanaris with a field testing kit. Zinge wants you to test tissue from desert creatures.

faq.q: Why do you need to see Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle?
faq.answer: The modified testing kit needs a power source like those held by Gadgetzan’s goblins. Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle can arrange one.

faq.q: Which beasts are targeted for testing?
faq.answer: You test Tanaris basilisks, scorpids and hyenas. Zinge needs eight acceptable samples of each.
